explanation: Bees build honeycomb from hexagons, which fit together with no gaps and use the least wax for the space they enclose. Thomas Hales proved this in 1999.

claims.text: A pentagon has five sides, a heptagon seven and an octagon eight.
Honeybees build their comb from hexagonal cells.
A grid of regular hexagons divides a flat surface into cells of equal area with the least total wall length.
Thomas Hales proved this, the honeycomb conjecture, in 1999.
